meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Implements Manus-style file-based planning to organize and track progress on complex tasks. Creates task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件规划并追踪多步骤复杂任务的进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要拆解并跟踪多步骤的复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Plan and track progress on multi-step complex tasks using files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down and track progress on complex multi-step tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为复杂任务创建三个 Markdown 文件（task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md），并用它们记录计划、发现和进度。每次决策前会重读计划，每完成一个阶段会更新文件。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、分解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务，或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。会话被 /clear 后会自动恢复。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，比如搭建一个博客网站。
我需要研究几个技术方案，请帮我整理发现。
say.note: Claude 会创建 findings.md 记录研究结果。

say.text: 继续之前中断的任务，恢复上下文。
say.note: Claude 会读取已有计划文件并恢复进度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates three Markdown files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) for complex tasks, using them to record plans, discoveries, and progress. It re-reads the plan before decisions and updates files after each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

say_en.text: Help me plan a multi-step project, like building a blog website.
say_en.note: Claude will create task_plan.md etc. and execute in phases.

say_en.text: I need to research several technical options, please organize findings.
say_en.note: Claude will create findings.md to record research results.

say_en.text: Continue the previously interrupted task and restore context.
say_en.note: Claude will read existing plan files and resume progress.
